Kind of disappointed by the ambiance and food
Jul 2019 • Friends
I've been meaning to try this place for almost a year now and finally did. Sadly, it was not everything that I wished it had been. As for the food, everything that we ordered was tasty. However, all of the portions were incredibly small for the price. I was shocked and annoyed by that. But also, the ambiance, was really challenging. We had an option to sit outside where the music was incredibly loud and where people were smoking. Or, we could sit inside where there was air conditioning. It was a really hot night so we sat inside. But, the staff kept going in and out of the tiny, air-conditioned dining area and leaving the doors open. So, the air conditioning was constantly being released into the outside. It was loud and uncomfortable in terms of volume and temperature. 

The staff was nice and the location is great! But, I'm afraid that this place won't be on our list of second times...

Decent Food. Nice Location. 3/5 Rating
May 2019 • Family
We had heard a lot about Fat Pigs so we decided to give it a go for dinner. The location is quite nice, right by the big lake. We walked up the staircase and were lucky to find a place to sit outside. The restaurant is not terribly large, so best to book a table. The service staff was quite friendly and spoke English, which was nice. The weather was quite pleasant as well, since it has been raining a bit. 

We ordered a couple of mains, side dishes and drinks. The cocktails (Old Fashion and Martini) were just okay, not exactly great. The burger though, was fantastic (5/5) and very flavorful and ideally we should have ordered two (since it was the best of the 3 main dishes we ordered). 

The pork ribs were okay, could have been more flavourful and juicy. Hot sauce and BBQ Dipping sauces seemed to be a bit too watered down, thus seemed a bit watery. So not exactly exciting.

The Mac n cheese was okay as well, couldn’t finish it, but the fries were awesome and so was the pulled wild boar. We also decided to order the house special matcha / mochi Japanese style brownie with ice-cream, which wasn’t terribly appealing as the ice cream seemed to be very icy and not at all creamy. What a pity. 

That said, we liked the ambience and the service was nice as well, but fell short of a good experience.

Oh well ! I’m Glad we checked the box to eat here, but I doubt we’ll eat here again.
